name: Nebreda (Spain)
description: Horizontal tricolour of light blue, red and green, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Nebreda (a tree, ears of wheat and a sheep).
history: Municipal flag of Nebreda; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Nebreda arms — tree, ears of wheat and sheep
